subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw support provider-native video as a first-class chat/model input, and if so through which core or plugin contract and raw-media security policy?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix crosses product API shape, provider routing, model capability metadata, raw-media egress, retention, and fallback behavior that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve first-class video input
options.body: Define a typed WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with explicit size, retention, egress, and fallback rules, then land or replace an implementation against that contract.

options.title: Keep video in media-understanding
options.body: Document the supported video.description media-understanding path and defer direct chat/model video uploads until a stronger product case exists.

options.title: Prove provider-specific paths first
options.body: Let provider plugins validate native video behavior behind provider-owned seams before adding a generic core chat-video content contract.

recommendation.title: Approve first-class video input
recommendation.body: Define a typed WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with explicit size, retention, egress, and fallback rules, then land or replace an implementation against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest visible routing context on this issue and adjacent current-main media/provider history.
